description: This file contains macro definitions for ADC (Analog-to-Digital Converter) mathematical operations, including conversions between ADC values and voltage, and macros for retrieving voltage readings.

methods.name: adcToVolts
methods.description: Converts ADC readings to volts based on engine configuration Vcc.

methods.name: voltsToAdc
methods.description: Converts volts to ADC units based on engine configuration Vcc.

methods.name: getVoltage
methods.description: Retrieves the voltage for the specified hardware channel.

methods.name: getVoltageDivided
methods.description: Calculates voltage from ADC value and applies input divider coefficient.
